title: TRELLIS.2 image to 3D (textured)
description: Local image-to-mesh with PBR textures (base color, metallic, roughness, normal, occlusion), built from the TRELLIS.2 branch of the official Pixal3D & TRELLIS.2 template; the editor-only viewer is replaced by SaveGLB. Used by Camera angles to render true viewpoints with real surface colors.

requirements.name: Trellis2ShapeStage
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version with native TRELLIS.2 nodes (comfy_extras.nodes_trellis2).

requirements.name: Trellis2TextureStage
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version with native TRELLIS.2 nodes (comfy_extras.nodes_trellis2).

requirements.name: RemoveBackground
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version with native background removal (comfy_extras.nodes_bg_removal).

requirements.name: BakeTextureFromVoxel
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version with native mesh post-processing nodes.

requirements.name: SaveGLB
requirements.instructions: Install a ComfyUI version providing SaveGLB.

requirements.name: trellis_2_int8_convrot.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Install the 5.25 GB TRELLIS.2 int8 model (MIT).

requirements.name: trellis_2_shape_vae_bf16.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Install the TRELLIS.2 shape VAE (1.10 GB, MIT).

requirements.name: trellis_2_texture_vae_bf16.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Install the TRELLIS.2 texture VAE (0.95 GB, MIT).

requirements.name: dino_v3_L_naf_fp32.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Install the DINOv3 encoder (1.22 GB, DINOv3 License).

requirements.name: birefnet.safetensors
requirements.instructions: Install BiRefNet background removal (0.44 GB, MIT).

evidence: 2026-10-24: direct native run on a teal-cup product fixture (texture 2048, 300k faces) succeeded in about 7 min and wrote comfyfield-trellis_00001_.glb (75,771,056 bytes; glTF 2; 1 mesh, 727,889 vertices; PBR material with base color, metallic-roughness, normal and occlusion, 3 images). RemeshMesh was rebuilt from the installed schema (sdf mode, defaults) because the template targets an older node version. App-ledger runs and other subjects remain unproven.
